subject: Renewal health + capacity uplift proposal for Nimbus Retail
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie@nimbusretail.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal check-in: usage spike + renewal window

Hi Rachel,

We're getting close to our annual renewal (June 10) and wanted to flag a couple of things from our side before we get to contract talks:

- Token spend has spiked ~40% MoM in March/April due to a marketing-driven increase in chat traffic. I attached our raw export (nimbus_usage_apr2027.csv) and a short latency sample.
- Our product team is concerned about sustained latency on long-context reranks; they saw jitter during big campaigns.
- We want to explore a mid-term capacity uplift (committed + burst) rather than a full-term reprice — ideally for the next six months while campaigns normalize.

Can you send a short usage/ROI recap and a proposal for a temporary uplift (committed tokens + burst headroom)? Also copying contracts (contracts@nimbusretail.com) so they're aware.

Thanks,
Ellie Park
Head of Product, Nimbus Retail

Attachments: nimbus_usage_apr2027.csv; latency-sample-202703.png
From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbusretail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: usage spike + renewal window

Hi Ellie — thanks for the heads up and the upload. I pulled your usage into a short summary and a one-page ROI snapshot (attached: redwood_q1_summary.pdf). High-level:

- Spend trend: tokens per day up ~38% since Feb. Most growth is in chat+rerank flows tied to two promotional campaigns.
- Unit economics: despite higher spend, cost per retained session has improved by ~12% because the model is handling more conversions.
- Latency: the jitter you're seeing matches periods where bursts hit a single region pool; we can reduce this by adding cross-region fallback and temporary burst capacity.

Proposal (short):
1) 3-month committed uplift: +25% baseline commit (applies to hosted API plan)
2) 2x burst headroom for campaign windows (pay-as-you-go above commit)
3) Temporary canary routing to a lower-latency model variant for rerank-heavy endpoints; we can toggle per-route.

If that sounds reasonable I can loop in Marissa for pricing and Sergio for the SLA/ops play to ensure the burst behavior and routing work as expected.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_q1_summary.pdf

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nimbus renewal — short-term uplift ask (FYI)

Internal — please do not forward outside Redwood.

Quick summary for context: Nimbus (RDW-4921) has a June 10 renewal. Product flagged a 38% token spike due to two marketing campaigns; latency jitter tied to regional capacity hits. Ellie asked for a 6-month uplift approach (committed + burst) rather than a full-term repricing.

My recommendation:
- Offer a 3-month trial uplift: +25% commit (billed monthly) with 2x burst headroom, then revert to baseline unless they convert to a longer-term commit.
- Show ROI: our Q1 summary indicates cost per retained session improved; use that in negotiation.
- Pricing ask: propose 12% blended discount on the uplifted commit (trade for 3-month guaranteed commit).

Marissa — can you run pricing options and provide a short amendment template? Sergio — can you confirm ops can support cross-region fallback + burst for the 3-month window and estimate any run-rate delta?

Rachel
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimbus renewal — short-term uplift ask (FYI)

Thanks Rachel — pricing options below (high level):

Option A (short): 3-month uplift = +25% commit at 12% discount (as proposed). No change to base term after 3 months.
Option B (convertible): 3-month uplift at 8% discount with an automatic conversion to a 6-month +10% commit if average daily usage remains >115% of baseline.
Option C (enterprise): 6-month uplift with deeper discount (18%) and a 90-day early-termination penalty.

Attachments: proposed-amendment.docx (legal-friendly wording for Option A and B).

Sergio — ops estimates for cross-region routing and burst: agree this is doable; minor configuration and extra monitoring (~2 engineering days to validate). I put a conservative estimate of $1.2k incremental monthly infra cost for the burst headroom on average peak months.

I'll prep a clean amendment for Ellie if you want me to send.

—Marissa

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimbus renewal — short-term uplift ask (FYI)

Confirmed — ops + infra check:
- Cross-region fallback: we can configure weighted routing to reduce single-region jitter.
- Burst headroom: supported via autoscaling policy (we'll enforce a per-customer burst cap and spike billing metric).
- Validation: ~2 engineering days to run an end-to-end smoke test and a day to update docs/alerts.
- Estimated incremental infra run-rate ~ $1.2k/month for peak campaign months (as Marissa noted), negligible during baseline months.

If legal wants specific SLA language around jitter during bursts we can offer a 99.5% regional availability target with automatic fallback clauses.

Sergio
From: Ellie Park <ellie@nimbusretail.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbusretail.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: usage spike + renewal window

Thanks — the summary and the options are very helpful. We're inclined to take Option A (3-month uplift at 12% discount) with the 2x burst headroom, and would like the amendment (Option A) to include:

- Start date: May 15, 2027
- Commit: +25% baseline for 3 months (monthly billing)
- Burst billing: PAYG at standard overage rates; please confirm the per-token overage rate on the amendment.
- Cross-region fallback enabled for rerank endpoints.

Can you send the Option A amendment and a draft PO? We'll aim to return signed amendment and PO within 5 business days once we confirm legal's minor edits.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ellie Park
Head of Product, Nimbus Retail
